owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
rows.pass: No shader program is compiled after the experience became interactive; stage times recorded for 200 samples per device and tier (docs/performance/budgets.md, proposal).
rows.procedure: Open Lissajous Labyrinth from the catalog with the testing argument, 200 times per device across the three host tiers; the campaign records preparation, shader set-up and first present as stage times.
rows.title: Launch and first frame

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
rows.pass: 60 frames per second with automatic levels (a documented 30 frames per second mode is acceptable on the last level), 200 samples per device; frame time per pinned tier recorded.
rows.procedure: Run the hero and full-playthrough scenarios pinned to tiers 0, 1 and 2 in turn, then with automatic levels; the campaign records each frame's interval.
rows.title: Frame pacing and frame time per tier

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner keeps the device unplugged for the stress session and tells the campaign the starting battery level.
rows.pass: Memory flat within the declared resource budget over the session (the growth rule of feature 192), 200 samples per device; thermal state and any tier change recorded.
rows.procedure: Run the 30-minute round-two stress session of UA-F13 (levels opened, played, undone and replayed in a loop) at automatic levels; the campaign samples the footprint and the thermal state.
rows.title: Memory, thermal state and the round-two stress session

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner turns the dial rings and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; turning a ring previews the dial value under the finger and one action is sent on release.
rows.procedure: Turn each of the four dial rings beside the figure and orbit the camera with two fingers on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Gesture feel and touch-to-frame latency

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner listens and feels, and sets the silent switch and the system haptics setting.
rows.pass: The loop is audible only while the sound is on, the panel is shown and the scene is active, and follows the silent switch; each planned haptic is felt (where the device has no haptic engine, the haptic part is recorded as not applicable).
rows.procedure: Turn the Sound toggle on and play a level to a win and to a failure with the haptics switch on; observe the ambient loop and the selection, success, warning and error haptics.
rows.title: Sound heard and haptics felt

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner turns VoiceOver and the text size on and off in Settings and performs the walk-through.
rows.pass: Every control is read with its label and value, pending values and actions are announced, the win is announced; the panel stays readable at the largest accessibility text size; recorded as an observation (non-gating, P-08).
rows.procedure: With VoiceOver on and the largest accessibility text size, set level 1's solution with the steppers as pending values, apply it and hear the win; replay it.
rows.title: VoiceOver walk-through (manual, non-gating)

rows.procedure: Win level 1, leave the app to the background, end it from the app switcher, reopen Lissajous Labyrinth.
rows.title: Progress across a real termination
